The new model is mail-in petitions (prepaid return envelope) requested through the website, plus 100+ grassroots partners; that model points away from paid field circulation. evidence: These are the only MA circulator pay rates found. The newest is from Aug 2025 (2026 cycle). No fall-2026 posting for 2028 petitions was found. These hourly rates are a useful benchmark against the per-signature model the Legislature is considering banning (Finegold bill).
